newsitem.title: CROATIA: US peace soldier killed in Croatia road crash.
newsitem.headline: US peace soldier killed in Croatia road crash.

text.p: A U.S. soldier was killed and another injured in eastern Croatia on Monday when their truck swerved off the road and fell into a culvert filled with water, NATO peace force officials said.
The soldier was found trapped in the truck's submerged cab and died later in hospital in the eastern Croatian town of Slavonski Brod.
Another U.S. soldier who was driving the truck was thrown clear in the accident and suffered minor injuries, said a statement by the U.S. peace force command in nearby Bosnia faxed to news agencies.
Names of the soldiers were withheld pending notification of their families.
The soldiers were serving with the 15,000-strong U.S. contingent in NATO's peacekeeping operation in Bosnia.
U.S. troops started pulling out of Bosnia earlier this month. Slavonski Brod currently serves as a staging area for their withdrawal.
